body.id: Sekitar 1.000 tahun lalu, kota Bagdad dan Bukhara penuh dengan perpustakaan dan ilmuwan.
body.en: About 1,000 years ago, the cities of Baghdad and Bukhara were full of libraries and scholars.

body.id: Al-Khwarizmi menulis buku hitung yang melahirkan kata aljabar dan algoritma.
body.en: Al-Khwarizmi wrote maths books that gave us the words algebra and algorithm.

body.id: Ibn Sina menulis buku kedokteran yang dipakai ratusan tahun.
body.en: Ibn Sina wrote a medical book that was used for hundreds of years.

body.id: Mohammad Hatta ikut memproklamasikan kemerdekaan dan dikenal sebagai Bapak Koperasi.
body.en: Mohammad Hatta helped proclaim independence and is known as the Father of Cooperatives.

body.id: B.J. Habibie merancang pesawat dan memimpin pembuatan pesawat N250.
body.en: B.J. Habibie designed aircraft and led the building of the N250 plane.

body.id: Keduanya belajar jauh di luar negeri, lalu pulang untuk membangun Indonesia.
body.en: Both studied far away abroad, then came home to build Indonesia.

ST-KHWARIZMI.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "al-Khwarizmi" (c. 780-c. 850; House of Wisdom, Baghdad, under al-Ma'mun; introduced Hindu-Arabic numerals and algebra to Europe; 'algorithm' and 'algebra' from Latin forms of his name and book title); MacTutor / Dictionary of Scientific Biography, "Al-Khwarizmi" (the algebra book solves everyday problems: measuring land, dividing inheritances; the numerals book explains 1-9 and 0 with place value).

caption.id: Al-Khwarizmi hidup sekitar 1.200 tahun lalu di Bagdad, kota besar di Irak. Ia ahli matematika dan bintang.
caption.en: Al-Khwarizmi lived about 1,200 years ago in Baghdad, a great city in Iraq. He was a master of mathematics and the stars.

caption.id: Ia bekerja di Baitul Hikmah, Rumah Kebijaksanaan. Di sana para ilmuwan menerjemahkan dan menulis buku dari banyak bangsa.
caption.en: He worked at the House of Wisdom. There, scholars translated and wrote books from many peoples.

caption.id: Ia menulis buku tentang angka 0 sampai 9 dari India. Dengan sepuluh angka itu, berhitung menjadi jauh lebih mudah.
caption.en: He wrote a book about the digits 0 to 9 from India. With those ten digits, arithmetic became much easier.

caption.id: Bukunya yang lain, al-Jabr, mengajarkan cara mencari bilangan yang belum diketahui. Dari situ lahir kata "aljabar".
caption.en: Another of his books, al-Jabr, taught how to find an unknown number. That is where the word "algebra" comes from.

caption.id: Ilmunya dipakai untuk mengukur tanah dan membagi warisan dengan adil. Bahkan kata "algoritma" berasal dari namanya!
caption.en: His maths was used to measure land and share inheritances fairly. Even the word "algorithm" comes from his name!

title.id: Ibn Sina, dokter yang gemar membaca
title.en: Ibn Sina, the doctor who loved to read

ST-IBN-SINA.source: MacTutor History of Mathematics (University of St Andrews), "Avicenna" (born c. 980, Afshana near Bukhara; physician at 18; cured the Samanid ruler Nuh II in 997 and gained access to the royal library; the Canon of Medicine was a standard text at medieval universities and used until the 1700s; died 1037 near Hamadan); IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, lunar crater "Avicenna".

caption.id: Ibn Sina lahir tahun 980 di dekat Bukhara, kini di Uzbekistan. Sejak kecil ia sangat cepat belajar.
caption.en: Ibn Sina was born in 980 near Bukhara, in today's Uzbekistan. From childhood he learned very fast.

caption.id: Ia membaca buku-buku kedokteran dan mencoba mengobati orang sakit. Umur 18 tahun, ia sudah menjadi dokter.
caption.en: He read medical books and tried to treat sick people. By the age of 18, he was already a doctor.

caption.id: Ketika ia menyembuhkan penguasa Bukhara, ia diizinkan membaca di perpustakaan istana. Ia membaca hampir semua bukunya!
caption.en: When he cured the ruler of Bukhara, he was allowed to read in the palace library. He read almost every book in it!

caption.id: Ia menulis Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb, buku besar tentang penyakit, obat, dan cara hidup sehat. Buku itu dipakai dokter di Asia dan Eropa selama ratusan tahun.
caption.en: He wrote the Canon of Medicine, a great book about illnesses, medicines and healthy living. Doctors in Asia and Europe used it for hundreds of years.

caption.id: Sebuah kawah di Bulan dinamai Avicenna, nama Latinnya. Dari Ibn Sina, kita belajar gemar membaca dan menolong orang sakit.
caption.en: A crater on the Moon is named Avicenna, his Latin name. From Ibn Sina we learn to love reading and to help the sick.

title.en: Bung Hatta and his chests of books

ST-HATTA.source: Bisnis.com, "Biografi Moh Hatta: latar pendidikan, gagasan ekonomi & legasinya" (born Bukittinggi, 12 August 1902; studied in Rotterdam from 1921; arrested 1934, Boven Digoel then Banda Neira; signed the proclamation 17 August 1945; first Vice President; died 14 March 1980); Spice Islands blog, "Hatta and Sjahrir in exile in Banda" (sixteen chests of books; Banda Neira 1936-1942; afternoon school for the island's children); Metro TV News, "Siapa Bapak Koperasi Indonesia?" (title given at the Kongres Koperasi, Bandung, 17 July 1953; Hari Koperasi 12 July).

caption.id: Mohammad Hatta lahir di Bukittinggi, Sumatra Barat, tahun 1902. Sejak kecil ia gemar membaca.
caption.en: Mohammad Hatta was born in Bukittinggi, West Sumatra, in 1902. He loved reading from an early age.

caption.id: Ia kuliah ekonomi di Belanda. Di sana ia belajar tentang koperasi, usaha yang dimiliki bersama oleh anggotanya.
caption.en: He studied economics in the Netherlands. There he learned about cooperatives, businesses owned together by their members.

caption.id: Karena memperjuangkan kemerdekaan, ia diasingkan pemerintah Belanda ke tempat yang jauh. Ia membawa enam belas peti buku!
caption.en: Because he fought for independence, the Dutch government exiled him far away. He took sixteen chests of books with him!

caption.id: Di Pulau Banda Neira, ia dan temannya, Sjahrir, membuka sekolah sore untuk anak-anak pulau.
caption.en: On the island of Banda Neira, he and his friend Sjahrir ran an afternoon school for the island's children.

caption.id: Pada 17 Agustus 1945, ia dan Soekarno memproklamasikan kemerdekaan Indonesia. Hatta menjadi wakil presiden pertama.
caption.en: On 17 August 1945, he and Soekarno proclaimed Indonesia's independence. Hatta became the first Vice President.

caption.id: Ia mendorong rakyat mendirikan koperasi supaya maju bersama. Karena itu ia disebut Bapak Koperasi Indonesia.
caption.en: He encouraged people to start cooperatives so they could get ahead together. That is why he is called the Father of Indonesian Cooperatives.

title.en: Habibie and the plane made in Indonesia

ST-HABIBIE.source: Wikipedia, "B. J. Habibie" (born 25 June 1936, Parepare; RWTH Aachen, Diplom-Ingenieur 1960, doctorate 1965; Messerschmitt-Bölkow-Blohm; returned 1974; led IPTN from about 1976; third President 1998-1999; died 11 September 2019); ITS News, "Selamat Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional" (N-250 Gatotkaca first flight 10 August 1995 in Bandung, origin of Hakteknas on 10 August).

caption.id: B.J. Habibie lahir di Parepare, Sulawesi Selatan, tahun 1936. Waktu kecil ia suka membaca dan bertanya tentang cara kerja benda.
caption.en: B.J. Habibie was born in Parepare, South Sulawesi, in 1936. As a boy he loved reading and asking how things work.

caption.id: Ia kuliah teknik pesawat di Aachen, Jerman, sampai menjadi doktor. Ia lalu bekerja di pabrik pesawat di sana.
caption.en: He studied aircraft engineering in Aachen, Germany, and earned a doctorate. Then he worked at an aircraft factory there.

caption.id: Tahun 1974, ia pulang ke Indonesia. Ia memimpin pabrik pesawat di Bandung dan melatih banyak insinyur muda.
caption.en: In 1974 he came home to Indonesia. He led the aircraft factory in Bandung and trained many young engineers.

caption.id: Pada 10 Agustus 1995, pesawat N250 Gatotkaca rancangan Indonesia terbang perdana di Bandung. Orang-orang bersorak gembira.
caption.en: On 10 August 1995, the N250 Gatotkaca, designed in Indonesia, made its first flight in Bandung. People cheered with joy.

caption.id: Kini 10 Agustus diperingati sebagai Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional. Dari Habibie, kita belajar bermimpi besar dan terus belajar.
caption.en: Today 10 August is National Technology Awakening Day. From Habibie we learn to dream big and keep learning.
